instructions.name: buy_leg_for_slip
docs: Buy one leg for slip. Backend calls this N times after place_slip_await.

instructions.name: cancel_slip
docs: Cancel slip if deadline passed or legs not bought.

instructions.name: claim_paused_bet
docs: Refund a user's original stake when the protocol is paused.

instructions.name: close_epoch
docs: Manually close an epoch and enable LP withdrawals.
Normally auto-triggered when the last market in the epoch settles.

accounts.name: epoch
docs: Epoch account for the current epoch — must match global_config.current_epoch.
Markets are always created under the active epoch so the epoch can track
how many markets need to settle before LP withdrawals are unlocked.

instructions.name: enable_epoch_withdrawals
docs: Enable withdrawals on an epoch vault (called when epoch settles).

accounts.name: caller
docs: Anyone can call expire — they receive the PDA rent.

instructions.name: init_epoch
docs: Create the on-chain Epoch account for the current epoch.
Must be called before any markets can be created in a new epoch.

instructions.name: opt_in_epoch_liquidity
docs: Opt into an epoch's liquidity pool.

instructions.name: pause_epoch
docs: Pause epoch — blocks deposits, withdrawals, and market creation.
Admin can pause at any time (e.g. between epochs or for emergency).

instructions.name: place_slip_await
docs: Place slip await: escrows stake, records legs, locks fixed odds.
Backend then fires N × buy_leg_for_slip.

instructions.name: publish_epoch
docs: Publish an epoch and its vault — announcement LPs see before opting in.

instructions.name: resolve_slip
docs: Resolve slip: finalize payout after all legs settled.

instructions.name: settle_slip_leg
docs: Settle one leg of a slip. Permissionless.

instructions.name: settle_with_proof
docs: Settle market using TxLINE on-chain proof validation.
Only authorized operators/admin can call this with valid proof data.
Flow:
1. Bot fetches proof from TxLINE API
2. Bot calls this instruction with Txoracle payload + strategy
3. Program validates proof via CPI to Txoracle
4. Market is settled with the derived outcome

accounts.name: daily_scores_merkle_roots
docs: PDA for daily scores Merkle roots.

accounts.name: caller
docs: The caller (must be an admin or authorized operator)

instructions.name: unpause_epoch
docs: Unpause epoch — re-enables deposits, withdrawals, and market creation.

instructions.name: update_market_odds_with_proof
docs: Update market odds after validating a TxLINE proof bundle on-chain.

instructions.name: withdraw_epoch_liquidity
docs: Withdraw liquidity after epoch settlement.

types.name: CorrelationMatrix
docs: Default correlation matrix for soccer markets (basis points).
Same-market outcomes are 0 (mutually exclusive within same market).
Cross-market correlations are empirical estimates.

fields.name: correlations
docs: Correlation scores as basis points (0-10000).
Stored as upper triangle: [1X2↔OU, 1X2↔GGNG, OU↔GGNG]
Index mapping: [0]=1X2↔OU, [1]=1X2↔GGNG, [2]=OU↔GGNG

types.name: Epoch
docs: Tracks the state of an epoch — a time-bounded period during which
markets are created and settled. LPs can only withdraw after their
epoch's markets have all settled.

types.name: EpochLpPosition
docs: Tracks an individual LP's position in an epoch vault

fields.name: owner
docs: The LP's public key

fields.name: epoch_id
docs: The epoch this position belongs to

fields.name: shares
docs: Number of LP shares held

fields.name: withdrawn
docs: Whether the LP has withdrawn their position

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA

types.name: EpochVault
docs: Tracks liquidity provided by LPs who opted into a specific epoch.
Each epoch has its own vault, isolating capital and preventing cross-epoch contamination.

fields.name: epoch_id
docs: The epoch this vault belongs to

fields.name: total_deposits
docs: Total base tokens deposited by LPs who opted into this epoch

fields.name: total_withdrawals
docs: Total base tokens withdrawn by LPs after epoch settlement

fields.name: total_shares
docs: Total LP shares minted for this epoch

fields.name: num_lps
docs: Number of LPs who have opted in

fields.name: created_at
docs: Timestamp when the epoch started

fields.name: closed_at
docs: Timestamp when the epoch ended (set at close)

fields.name: withdrawals_enabled
docs: Whether withdrawals are enabled

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA

types.name: GlobalConfig
docs: Simplified GlobalConfig for fixed odds sports betting

types.name: LimitOrder
docs: A peer-to-peer limit order for outcome tokens.
Sell orders: creator locks outcome tokens in escrow at placement.
Buy orders:  creator locks USDC collateral in treasury at placement.
Either side can be partially filled. The creator can cancel at any time
to recover locked assets. Anyone can expire an order past its deadline.

types.name: Market
docs: Simplified Market for fixed odds sports betting
Odds are stored as basis points (e.g., 200 = 2.00x payout)

fields.name: odds
docs: Fixed odds per outcome in basis points (10000 = 1.0x, 20000 = 2.0x)
For 1X2: [home_odds, draw_odds, away_odds]
For O/U: [over_odds, under_odds]
For GG/NG: [gg_odds, ng_odds]

types.name: MarketGroup
docs: MarketGroup with correlation matrix for LP protection.
Each market (1X2, O/U, GG/NG) settles independently with its own oracle submission.
Correlation matrix reduces bonus/payout for correlated leg combinations.

fields.name: market_ids
docs: Market IDs in order: 1X2(0), O/U(1), GG/NG(2)

fields.name: correlation_matrix
docs: Correlation matrix between markets in this group

types.name: OrderSide
